# data.Store: beforeSetData() => temp record ids

`collection.Base` provides support for adding new items without an id (keyProperty) value, using negative unique indexes:
https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/src/collection/Base.mjs#L1153

`data.Store` needs to use this as well.

### Ticket Intake & Contract Ledger (`ticket-intake` §0 / §1.7 / §1.8)

- **Prescription check (`§0`):**
  - When `#3559` was filed in 2022, `Store#beforeSetData` contained the record-instantiation loop (`RecordFactory.createRecord(me.model, item)`). In `#6444` (`1322a90ab0`), that loop moved into `Store#createRecord(config)` (invoked via `Store#prepareAddedItems(items)` in `add()` and `insert()`, or directly via `store.createRecord()`).
  - Currently in `src/data/Store.mjs`:
    1. **Eager Mode (`createRecord`):** `Store#createRecord` calls `RecordFactory.createRecord(me.model, item)` before `Collection#splice` runs. When `item` has no key (`me.getKey(item) == null`) and the model's key field has no `calculate` or non-null `defaultValue`, `Record` is constructed with `id: undefined`. Direct `store.createRecord(item)` calls therefore return a keyless record, while `add()` / `insert()` / `data = ...` rely on `Collection#splice` mutating `item[keyProperty] = me.keyPropertyIndex` on the already-constructed `Record` via its public setter — which marks the new record dirty (`isModified === true`), increments `record.version` a second time, fires a spurious `recordChange` event mid-`splice` (`index: -1`), and breaks `store.map` lookup when the key field has `type: 'String'` (`'-1'` on the record vs `-1` in `store.map`).
    2. **Lazy / Turbo Mode (`hydrateRecord`):** When `autoInitRecords: false`, `Collection#splice` assigns numeric `me.keyPropertyIndex` (`-1`, `-2`, ...) to the raw item and keys `me.map` / `me.allItems.map` by that numeric key. If the Model's key field has `type: 'String'`, `Store#hydrateRecord` converts the key to `'-1'` (`pk`), so `me.map.has(pk)` misses and leaves the raw item in `me.map`.
  - Assigning `[keyProperty]: me.keyPropertyIndex--` on a shallow copy of keyless raw items in `Store#createRecord` before `RecordFactory.createRecord(me.model, item)` and reconciling coerced `rawKey -> pk` map keys in `Store#hydrateRecord` gives `Neo.data.Store` full temporary record id support across both Eager and Turbo modes without mutating caller input objects or dirtying freshly created records.
- **Core-Idiom Pre-Flight (`§9.6`):** Read `src/core/Base.mjs`, `src/Neo.mjs`, `src/state/Provider.mjs`, `src/data/Model.mjs`, `src/data/RecordFactory.mjs`, `src/data/Store.mjs`, and `src/collection/Base.mjs`.

#### Contract Ledger

| Surface | Path / Symbol | Contract | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eager Record Creation | `Neo.data.Store#createRecord` (`src/data/Store.mjs`) | Assigns `this.keyPropertyIndex--` to `[keyProperty]` on a shallow copy of raw items lacking a key (`this.getKey(item) == null`) when the model key field defines no `calculate` or non-null `defaultValue`, before calling `RecordFactory.createRecord(this.model, item)`. | `test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs` |
| Lazy / Turbo Hydration | `Neo.data.Store#hydrateRecord` (`src/data/Store.mjs`) | Reconciles `this.map` and `this.allItems.map` when record hydration coerces the raw item's temporary key (`rawKey`, e.g. `-1`) to a typed key (`pk`, e.g. `'-1'`). | `test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs` |
